findings.summary: All six party members fainted; the verified clone ended in whiteout.

The unchanged Bugatti bundle will not be retried.

findings.summary: By Eelektrik entry, every remaining answer was already damaged, burned, or expendable; Eelektrik then swept the remains.

resolution.observed: The new Coppertop profile was checked against a full-HP active Bibarel opening and a verified Eelektrik battle state; Coppertop is healthy with Tackle, Bulldoze, and Rock Smash, and the policy selects Tackle with no action-changing uncertainty.

findings.summary: 18 switches in 28 actions repeatedly traded HP for position without closing Ponyta quickly.
The loss consumed 28 verified actions before whiteout.

correct_choices: Spark was used twice to remove Bibarel.
Bulldoze was the correct opening attack into Ponyta.
Fresh-entry Fake Out was used on Ohmnomnom and Croakatoa when legal.
Aerial Ace removed Ponyta before Eelektrik entered.
Poison Touch plus Fake Out poisoned and flinched Eelektrik.
All 28 action results and the terminal whiteout were RAM-verified with no observation/execution discrepancy.
